title: Out-of-bound buffer read in ST_NumPoints() and ST_NumGeometries() of a truncated WKB
summary:
### Impact
GIS functions, such as `ST_NumPoints()`, `ST_NumGeometries()` and `ST_IsValid()`, did not verify that a LineString, MultiPoint, MultiLineString or MultiPolygon in WKB format was long enough to contain the number of elements. For a truncated WKB value they read 4 bytes beyond the end of the buffer, and `ST_NumPoints()` and `ST_NumGeometries()`  returned these bytes to the user.

### Workarounds
There is no workaround.
